steps.text: (...It burns...)
(...It hurts...)

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: So, the wench still won't speak up?
(So thirsty... My throat feels like it's on fire...)
( ...How long have I been here...?)

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Hah, what a trooper... She's been dangling here for more than a day, but still won't crack.

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Oi, don't kill her off just yet. She still hasn't told us where the treasure is!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: ...I'm not... telling you anything...

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Have it your way then. Don't give her any water until she decides to cooperate!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: (Am I... going to die?)
So, even in Kazimierz...
...the ruffians run amok everywhere.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Hmm? Huh? Who the hell are you? You got a death wish?

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Oi, kiddo, hurry and scram before...

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Gaaah! That... that hurt...!

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: That outfit of his... He's not from these parts.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Who the hell cares where he's from! The moron sure doesn't value his life if he wants to fight us all by himself!
So, I'm guessing the diplomatic approach isn't going to work?

steps.name: Violent Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Unngh!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Guhh...
Good. They won't be bothering us for a while. Let's leave while we still can.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Who... are you...?
Don't be afraid, nobody's going to hurt you anymore. I'll get you out of here.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: I'm sorry... My head is... still spinning...
You look pretty pale. Don't worry, let me carry you then.
Hold on tight.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Mm...
Clear \ Visibility: 14 km
Nearby Village

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Have any of you seen a kid with a spear?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I was inside the whole time. I didn't see what was going on outside.

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: You're gonna be real damn sorry if I find out you've been hiding them!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: They've left, Miss Grani. It's safe for you two to come out now.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Hup~!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Looks like I owe you another one, Mister!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Are you okay, Carol? I'm sorry you had to go through that.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Thank you, Luke. I'm doing much better now.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I wouldn't have been able to rescue you without everyone's help.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Don't worry, Carol!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: We've been helping out this young knight here! She promised that she'd save our village!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Huh? She?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Ah, that's right. I'm a girl.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Aww, come on! I might not look it, but I'm a proper maiden on the inside!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Ah, um, sorry...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: It's hard to tell from your outfit, but...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Excuse me, are you... the knight from Kazimierz... who was recently anointed?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: After you save our village... Will you make us pay tribute?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: No, no. I'm not actually a knight, nor am I even from Kazimierz.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Even though Victoria does have knights, I was actually just a member of the Mounted Police!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Unlike the knights, our only job is to maintain public security. We don't ask for any payment in our line of duty, so of course we wouldn't tax you!

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Victoria?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: It's the land that lies beyond Kazimierz. My ancestors were actually all Kurantas who moved there from Kazimierz.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I came after receiving your village's request for aid. I also wanted to see what my parents' homeland was like, but... I didn't expect the situation to be so dire.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: ...Sending those pleas for help... felt like leaving messages in the bottle.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: We're used to most non-governmental organizations ignoring us because we're in such a remote location...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: I wonder, why didn't the Kazimierz government send out any assistance?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Hmph... Why would those high-and-mighty knights even bother coming all the way out here?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Even without their help, we've lived here peacefully for many years. The hustle and bustle of the city simply has no appeal for us.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: For generations, the people of Dewville have lived by these mountains.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: We might not be wealthy, but we do have a self-sufficient way of life.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: And though we've sometimes had to evacuate to escape from Catastrophes, this is still our home.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: That's why... we can't give up this land...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: But now, the bounty hunters have brought destruction in their wake...

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: ...All because of those 'Knights' Treasures.'

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Over the last few years, the villages around here have become the bounty hunters' stomping grounds.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: I heard that a region in the northern part of Kazimierz has been in turmoil, and that has attracted hordes of bounty hunters looking to strike it rich. Apparently, the only way to get up north runs right by our village.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: In the past, plenty of bounty hunters used to pass through, but they never caused any problems.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: But about a month ago, some bounty hunters dug up a knight's sarcophagus from these mountains. They even found a small chest of gold coins...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Gold coins with the Kazimierz crest on them, like these?

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Those bounty hunters tried to pick a fight with me as soon as I arrived. I relieved them of these coins as compensation for their rudeness.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Mhm... these are the same coins. Our troubles began when a certain saying began to circulate among the bounty hunters.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: 'The ancient Knights of Kazimierz were all buried with their riches near the lands they once called home. Their souls protect these unmarked graves for all of eternity.'

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: 'Only those who fear not sacrifice and possess the true, dauntless bloodline of Kazimierz may open the path.'

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: Rumors such as these keep spreading, and more and more bounty hunters have been drawn here.

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: At first, all they used to do was discuss where to look for the next big find. But for some reason, they soon started spreading the idea that the villagers knew where the treasures were buried...

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: —Shh! Everyone, quiet!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: What do you mean, you couldn't find them? Double back and search harder this time!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: It's not safe to stay here. We can't let any more innocents get dragged into this.

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Anyway, let's get out of here first.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Stay safe out there, Miss Knight... I mean, Officer! Please take care of our Chief!

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Don't worry, Mister. I'll be sure to protect—

steps.name: Grani
steps.text: Huh? Chief?

steps.name: Carol
steps.text: ...I've only been on the job for about half a year, but that'd be me... I might not look it, but I'm a proper chief on the inside~
